Never lower the retention on ledgerly’s audit-log BigQuery dataset below 365 days; cost reduction proposals must target non-audit datasets and be documented in infra/bigquery-costs.md.

Always emit invoice-reconciliation timing through the existing `invoice_reconcile_seconds` histogram with labels limited to `service`, `environment`, `status`, and `tenant_tier`.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
